text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A fitting maxim for a time like this would be...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...It's no good. Nothing's coming to mind at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sakura Chiyono O has built up
a lot of fatigue from her races.
It might be best to review her race schedule.
